author: The Current
description:
Jeremy Gaudet of the band Kiwi Jr. talks about signing to K Records
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Toronto band Kiwi Jr. latest album, “Blowin’ Up” — the band’s fourth album since 2019 — marks Kiwi Jr.’s first release on the Olympia, Washington-based label K Records. “It's cool to be on K now,” Kiwi Jr. frontman Jeremy Gaudet says. “[It was] always on our mind as an inspirational label and home to a lot of great artists.”

Hear more about what Gaudet has to say about Kiwi Jr. and K Records in the video above.

Watch Kiwi Jr.'s full session here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KEWGhBAk_P0
